title: papaver alpinum var. aurantiacum
intro: Papaver alpinum var. aurantiacum, commonly known as Alpine Poppy, is a variety of flowering plant that belongs to the Papaveraceae family. It has been traditionally used in folk medicine to treat various health conditions due to its numerous health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The plant is known to exhibit therapeutic actions such as analgesic, antispasmodic, and antitussive effects, which can help alleviate pain, reduce inflammation, and relieve respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of Papaver alpinum var. aurantiacum include alkaloids, glycosides, and phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
